title: carum sogdianum
intro: Carum sogdianum, commonly known as Dukhurana or Persian cumin, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae that is native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia, including Afghanistan, Pakistan, and parts of India. The health benefits of Carum sogdianum include its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its carminative, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve gas, reduce swelling, and expel mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Carum sogdianum include a variety of compounds such as volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
